brief:
Israeli occupation authorities demolished a Palestinian home in Beit Hanina, north of occupied Jerusalem, on Monday, IMEMC News reported. The demolition is part of a pattern affecting Palestinian residents across the area, where additional families face potential displacement under standing demolition orders from Israeli authorities.

The Jerusalem Governorate documented the operation. Israeli demolitions in Palestinian neighborhoods of East Jerusalem have accelerated in recent years, with residents frequently receiving orders to vacate or face forced removal of their structures. The action in Beit Hanina adds to mounting displacement pressures on Palestinian communities in and around the capital.
